The merge computes the second task vector against the already-merged intermediate (`f2 - tmp`) instead of the unmodified base (`f2 - b`), yielding `b + λ(f1−b) + λ(f2 − b − λ(f1−b))`, which differs from the required formula by `−λ²(f1−b)`. This violates Required result step 2 (`out[X] = base[X] + λ(ft1[X]−base[X]) + λ(ft2[X]−base[X])`) and the ordering hazard the specification explicitly warns about, so the 64 merged tensors will generally exceed the 1e-3 relative Frobenius tolerance.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
